core_obligations: Compactification: choose j : X -> \overline{X} and \overline{f} : \overline{X} -> Y as in the construction of Rf_! (proof lines 3943-3944).
Tensor through j_!: j_!E tensor \overline{f}^{-1}K = j_!(E tensor f^{-1}K) by the j-shriek and tensor lemma (proof lines 3944-3947).

Conclusion: apply the proper projection formula lemma, using f^{-1} = j^{-1} after \overline{f}^{-1} and Rf_! = R\overline{f}_* after j_!, to obtain Rf_!E tensor K = Rf_!(E tensor f^{-1}K) (proof lines 3948-3952).
proof_roadmap: Proper projection formula and the two construction equalities (proof lines 3948-3952).
